evidence_limitations.failed_stage_post_checks: The original runner asserted success before its final input check. Failed stages bind entry inputs only; later checks are explicitly later evidence.
evidence_limitations.initial_native_suites: Nine core ASan suites verified 303 prepared inputs, excluding three Python files still under review. Later complete stages bind all 307 initial inputs.
evidence_limitations.layout_failure: First Release used a sibling build directory and failed executable-relative resource discovery in doctor_diagnostics_cli and review_cli_smoke (76/78). Source-local rebuild then passed both full Release gates, without product/test changes.
evidence_limitations.asan_failure: Both the overlapping four-suite integration gate and the quiet complete 16-method billing rerun failed case04 at the original single-Agent 60000ms batch deadline; test99 consequently retained one failed paired cell. Quiet failure rules out a claim that contention alone explains the failure. No sanitizer diagnostic was found.

initial_candidate_capture.reason: Preserve exact first audit candidate before any later performance changes; source plus metadata only, no databases or binaries.

differences: Diagnostic translation units have timing instrumentation and one extra -I pointing to the unchanged frozen src directory for non-instrumented Store includes.
Both compiler command lines omit -O flags and use the same /usr/bin/c++ with Debug -g and -fsanitize=address; no optimization flags were added for the diagnostic build.
Neither compile nor link adds an explicit PIE override; both observed executables are ET_DYN with PT_INTERP.

Diagnostic link injects twelve instrumented objects before the same frozen static libraries, changing code layout. Its successful 223.401-second run is diagnostic evidence, not a replacement gate or a speed comparison against the uninstrumented audit failures.

diagnostic_profile.interpretation: Diagnostic instrumented binary only, not a production gate. Inclusive nested times cannot be summed. Compile flags matched Debug ASan without optimization; instrumentation and overlay object layout differ. Original case04 deadlines were retained.
